how_to_run: Paste each prompt into a fresh session with the stated connector state. Check every must_include and must_not_include against the reply. A case passes only if all checks hold.

cases.connector_state: B - books connected, bank not connected
cases.prompt: Here are 24 months of monthly P&L from Zoho Books. Build the FY27 budget. We are 24 people, plan to hire 7, and expect 25% growth because we are doubling ad spend.

must_include: a driver list with last year's actual beside this year's assumption
cost split by behaviour: fixed, variable, step, with hire months
monthly seasonality taken from the actuals, not a flat line
envelopes with a named owner each
a cash page with the lowest month named
one line naming the bank statement as missing
must_not_include: a flat 1/12 of an annual number presented as a monthly plan

cases.pass_criteria: Driver-based build, step costs at their real months, envelopes owned, cash view present, and the missing bank connector named in one line.

cases.prompt: Make us a budget for next year.

must_include: one clarifying message asking for actuals and the driver list together
a statement of what can be built without them - frame, driver structure, envelope sheet, approval note
the two connectors that would unblock it, ranked, with what each unlocks
must_not_include: a full twelve-month budget with invented numbers
an industry-average growth rate presented as their assumption

cases.pass_criteria: Asks once for the minimum set, offers the structure it can build now, and does not fabricate a single line.

cases.connector_state: C - nothing connected, user pastes a 12-month revenue total only
cases.prompt: Revenue last year was 4.2 crore. Build the budget and tell me my lowest cash month.

must_include: the lowest-cash-month answer refused as unanswerable without payments timing
what can be done from a single annual total - an increment frame, explicitly labelled as such
a named ask: the books for cost by month, the bank statement for cash timing
must_not_include: a cost structure guessed from industry norms and stated as fact

cases.pass_criteria: Refuses the cash question, delivers the honest partial, names the two connectors with what each unlocks.

cases.connector_state: A - Google Sheets connected, user asks for a bank reconciliation
cases.prompt: The bank balance and Tally do not match by 1.8 lakh. Also, while you are in there, update the budget for October.

must_include: the reconciliation routed to finance-ops with one reason
the October budget update done from the sheet that is connected
a statement that an unreconciled ledger makes the October actual provisional
must_not_include: an attempt to reconcile the bank inside this skill
an October variance read presented as final while the books do not tie

cases.pass_criteria: Splits the two jobs, does the one it owns, routes the other by name, and flags the data-quality consequence.

cases.prompt: Budget approved. Now build the deck for the board meeting on the 24th and write the minutes after.

must_include: handoff to board-reporter for the pack and the minutes, and presentation-designer for the deck
the artefacts handed over: the plan in six lines, the three assumptions, the scenario ladder, the lowest cash month
the monthly variance pack named as this skill's continuing deliverable

cases.pass_criteria: Hands off with a complete package and keeps the variance cycle, without doing either neighbour's job.
